items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I had four different drummers. Four outstanding drummers. ... Krupa Gene Cooper -- it was our -- and Cozy Cozy and Buddy Rich. And it was four drummers -- outstanding drummers that I was gonna use.

ctx.x: I was gonna use like Cozy Cole, Buddy Rich. I had four different drummers. Four outstanding drummers.
Krupa Gene Cooper -- it was our -- and Cozy Cozy and Buddy Rich. And it was four drummers -- outstanding drummers that I was gonna use.
Louie Jordan was coming back in to do his part. Everybody -- Taft was coming -- everybody Off. was getting (Inaudible).
